data.long_meaning: Name derived from Old English 'ācer' meaning 'oak' and 'leah' meaning 'woodland clearing'. This name likely refers to a clearing in the woods where oaks grow. The name Akerley carries the meaning “Acer's clearing” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Akerley usually hope their child will grow to embody acer's clearing and live with faith, good character and purpose.
